description: Sign in to Lagos Life. Call session_status first; use login only if not already signed in. Collect lagoslife_username and lagoslife_password via emit_display interaction_mode input (pipeline_name login) after preview permission — never ask for password in chat text. Password is used only for the game login and is not echoed in chat.

lagoslife_password.description: Account password (secret; never repeat back to the user).

lagoslife_username.description: Lagos Life username or phone (handle without @).

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

name: login
